atts.title: Vesta Atelier
atts.subtitle: A boutique interior studio and bespoke furniture showroom shaping warm minimal spaces through tactile materiality, chromatic anchoring, and textural layering.

atts.label: Enter the showroom

atts.title: Color, proportion, and comfort in perfect balance.
atts.subtitle: The living space is composed like a tailored interior vignette, where charcoal restraint cushions the composition against vibrant ochre, oak, and smoked-glass highlights.

atts.subtitle: Mid-century modernism Tactile materiality Spatial ergonomics

atts.subtitle: A measured palette of ochre, charcoal, and light oak creates visual calm with gallery-level contrast.

atts.title: Shelves that assemble themselves as you scroll.
atts.heading: h2

atts.text: Coffee-table geometry becomes a modular display system, with shelves, objects, and finishes revealed in a rhythmic sequence.

steps.title: Sculpted side table
steps.content: Rounded-linear edges, smoked walnut grain, and a floating base tuned for compact living rooms.

steps.title: Textured throw
steps.content: Soft-woven materiality that introduces warmth without breaking the architectural silence.

steps.title: Table lamp
steps.content: Warm amber diffusion against dark stone and oak surfaces.

steps.title: Low-slung storage
steps.content: An elongated cabinet designed for visual grounding, keeping the room clean while echoing the horizontal lines of the wall slats.

steps.title: Stone tray
steps.content: Mineral texture, quiet edges, and a pale surface that catches the room’s amber glow.

steps.title: Leather accent chair
steps.content: Deep seat geometry with a refined tactile finish that absorbs and returns light.

atts.title: A controlled burst of leaf green and petal pink.
atts.subtitle: Plants and flowers enter as color punctuation, breaking the dark material palette with a softer, living cadence. The result feels curated, not decorative.
atts.heading: h2

atts.title: Grounding the room with living texture.
atts.content: A vertical plant composition softens the edges of the interior, echoing the upholstery and drawing the eye upward.

atts.title: A delicate counterpoint to charcoal and oak.
atts.content: Floral color introduces a quiet tension, amplifying the warm woods and shadowed surfaces around it.

atts.title: The room ends in warmth, weight, and quiet precision.
atts.subtitle: Vesta Atelier frames interiors as a balance of structure and softness, where every surface is tuned to feel intentional, tactile, and timeless.
